products.name: Poggio la Noce 2025 EVOO, 500ml
products.tagline: New Harvest 2025! This was an olive a few short weeks ago!
products.description: It's here... the 2025 Harvest!! We look forward to this oil coming out every fall - it is truly an amazing representation of true Tuscan olive oil. With hints of freshly cut grass, almonds & artichokes, it's not just one of our favorite oils, it happens to be produced by a couple of our favorite people - husband and wife team, Enzo Schiano and Claire Beliard. The olives from their 1,500 tree grove are hand-picked and pressed on the estate the same day. This helps to preserve all the intense flavor and fragrance of the olives and ensures the lowest grade of acidity possible. This oil was in it's olive state just a few short weeks ago, and in a few more short weeks, it will be gone...get it while you can, when it's gone, it's gone!

products.name: Staff Pick- Give Wine
products.tagline: Give the gift of great wine this year - choose your color, set your budget and how many bottles you want to send!
products.description:
Not sure what to get someone this year? Got a big wine fan in your life? Need to send something to some great clients of yours?

Don't worry - we've got you covered!

Select your budget, how many bottles you want to send, and any stylistic preferences, and we'll do the rest!

products.name: Give Chocolate
products.tagline: A hand-picked selection of the best chocolate!
products.description:
So you come into the store and see the walls of chocolate bars from all over the world and right down the street. It's beautiful, but it's confusing...you look around and find someone in a green apron. You tell that person you want to get some nice chocolate bars for your chocolate loving family member, friend, colleague or...yourself. They quickly pick out the bars you need and BAM! It's done and everyone is happy. This is just like that. Tell us how much you would like to spend and whether you prefer dark, milk, or a mix of the two! We'll take it from there!

*This is a gift, so we will remove the prices!

products.name: Snacksville
products.tagline: A hand-picked collection of salty snacks!
products.description:
There are sweet people, and there are savory people. Some go back and forth, some stay entrenched in their world of sugar or salt. We love both parties, but this gift is for the savory people. If you know someone who likes things that crunch, this is the ticket. Truffle chips, Bazzini Pistachios, Uncle Jerry's Pretzels, Toketti crackers, Taralli, fancy French Cheetos, Flufa...the list goes on! You choose the dollar amount, we handle the snacks. The type & number of items will depend on your budget and we have in stock. One click = a lot of snacks!

*This is a gift, we'll remove the prices!

products.name: The Cookie Aisle
products.tagline: A hand picked selection of our favorite cookies & sweets!
products.description:
Let's make a few assumptions...you like cookies & you also know someone who really likes cookies. As we do, you also enjoy being surrounded by hundreds of packaged cookies & sweets that appeal to most, if not all of your cookie cravings. We don't grow out of this folks, and that's a good thing. If you know someone like this/us, then they will love this gift. You choose your budget, we choose the cookies. The number of packages and the variety will vary with the dollar amount. Mulino Bianco, Stroopwaffles, Confectionally Yours Toffee, Nutella, Ghiottini Cantucci, seasonal favorites...the list goes on!

*This is a gift, so we will remove the prices!

products.name: The Gift of Cheese
products.tagline: Hand picked cheeses from our deli case - includes crackers!
products.description:
Cheese is many things, among them, it's a fantastic gift! By selecting this option, you are putting yourself in the hands of our deli crew. If you have a special someone who loves everything cheese, then this is your option. Our expert staff will put together a selection that is not only delicious, but also interesting and complimentary. Let go of the wheel and allow us to make you look like the cheese hero that you are! Comes with the appropriate amount of crackers too!

*Since this is a gift, we will keep the prices off the items.

products.name: Get Sauced!
products.tagline: Includes 5+ bottles of unique hot sauce!
products.description:
Heat is good, heat with flavor is better. This gift is for the person that has been known to carry their favorite hot sauce in their purse or pocket..just in case. Hot sauces aren't a one size fits all situation. You need a sauce for every occasion & a fully stocked hot sauce bar can add the finishing touch to the food you worked so hard to create. Or, it can salvage the food that you didn't work so hard on at all. Either way, the stuff is important.

Includes 4 to 6 bottles of hot sauce.

products.name: The Grand Salame
products.tagline: A hand picked assortment of salame from our meat case!
products.description:
You have to have a salame lover on your list. Perhaps it's you? Dad? Grandpa? Either way, just tell us how much you would like to spend, and we will pick out a great selection for that special someone on your list. We are going to stick to small format sticks & chunks of delicious salame to ensure they keep well. The number of sticks in the assortment and the variety with vary with the budget you choose. If the meat case is this person's favorite section of the store, this gift is for them!

*Since this is a gift, we will keep the prices off the items.

products.name: Tis' the Seasoning
products.tagline: A handpicked selection of salts & spices!
products.description:
We know, horrible play on words - too easy. It doesn't change the fact that we all need salt & seasoning to survive. Think of this collection as a food survival kit. If the recipient is to take a beautiful piece of beef, pork, or fish, or that perfect grilled vegetable or pasta and transform it into something memorable, he/she is going to need some help. Break out a full arsenal of finishing salts, herbs, ground peppers & aromatics and they will be good to go. You choose the dollar amount, we go to the salt/spice nook and go to town!

*This is a gift, we will remove the prices!

products.description: Our ample sized canvas tote bag is a staple in our store and around the Pike Place Market! Fly your DeLaurenti colors while carrying what you need around town! products.description: You say you don't know what part of the pig your favorite cured cuts of meat come from? Well, you will now when you are wearing them on your chest! No skimping on the materials here. This is a top quality tri-blend shirt with a soft feel and a perfect fit. products.name: The San Juan Sixer
products.tagline: 6 San Juan Sea Salt varieties to bring the flavor!
products.description: This is the six pack that isn't gone in an evening and won't keep you from driving home. The folks at San Juan quite literally flavor the lives of the customers & staff at DeLaurenti. Their wide range of classic and uniquely flavored salts & seasonings will rush to your aid when flavoring everything from your perfectly grilled steak to your popcorn on movie night. This gift brings the flavor in a big way to whoever is lucky enough to receive it! We chose our Top 6 customer favorites - hard to exclude any of them! You get...Classic Sea Salt, Popcorn Seasoning, Lemon Pepper, Daily Grind (melange of salt/pepper/spice in a grinder), Burger & Steak Blend & French Fry Seasoning!

products.name: The Pasta Course
products.tagline: Serves 4 with leftovers once, or 2 twice!
products.description:
This is a no brainer gift for anyone...including you. Can't take them to dinner? Don't want to take them to dinner? Give them an easy dinner instead!

The description of this item is pretty self-explanatory - DeLaurenti Fresh Egg Linguine (or Tirrena linguine if shipping ground), DeLaurenti Sugo della Casa, a hunk of Parmiggiano-Reggiano & a bottle of Italian red wine. Serves 2 twice, or up to 4 with some left overs. Add another bottle of wine if just one won't do!

products.name: Delaurenti Sugo al Porcini & Garganelli
products.description: Our house brand tomato and porcini sauce is made with ripe Italian tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. And yes, there are real porcini mushrooms in this sauce. Perfect paired with Rustichella's Garganelli - a penne rigate-like cut that is a touch more delicate. Finish your pasta with some Parmigiano-Reggiano and you are set!

products.name: DeLaurenti Sugo Alla Puttanesca & Calamarata
products.description: Our house brand Puttanesca sauce is made with Italian cherry tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. Add green olives, capers and pine nuts and you have a sweet, savory and mildly spicy version of a regional favorite. Perfect with Rustichella's Calamarata - a striking cut reminiscent of calamari rings! Serves 4

products.name: DeLaurenti Sugo alla Vodka & Penne Rigate
products.description: Our house brand Sugo alla Vodka is made with ripe Italian tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. The sauce is finished with a dash of vodka, fresh cream, garlic and basil. Classically paired with Rustichella's Penne Rigate! Serves 4

products.name: DeLaurenti Sugo della Casa & Spaghetti
products.description: This is your spaghetti dinner for 4 without the fuss. Our sugo della casa (house sauce) is imported from Italy and made with ingredients you can pronounce. It is great as is with Rustichella Spaghetti, but also highly customizable. Add sausage, pancetta, meat balls, red pepper flakes or fresh herbs to take it up a notch or two! As always, finishing with freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano or Pecorino is a must! Serves 4

products.name: DeLaurenti Sugo Due Formaggi & Rigatocini
products.description: Our house brand Sugo Due Formaggi is made with ripe Italian tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. Add sharp aged pecorino, creamy ricotta and fresh herbs and you have perfect sauce for Rustichella's Rigatocini! Serves 4

products.name: DeLaurenti Sugo Piccante & Bucatini
products.description: This combination is a classic - warmly spiced, fresh tomato sauce with toothsome bucatini. It is great as is, but easy to customize a quick version of Bucatini All'Amatriciana. To do so, saute some pancetta in the pan while your pasta is cooking. Add the sauce and simmer. Combine the cooked bucatini with the sauce and a half a cup of pasta water, and finish with some Pecorino Romano! Serves 4.

products.name: Pesto & Trofie
products.description: Most things are better when you make them yourself, but the best basil is not available 12 months a year. Made in the Ligurian city of Genoa, the birthplace of pesto, the ingredients in this sauce will seem hauntingly familiar: Ligurian basil, extra virgin olive oil, pine nuts & pecorino. Although it is perfect with any cut of pasta, try it the traditional way with Rustichella Trofie, thin blanched green beans & halved baby red potatoes.

products.name: Spedalotto Tonda Iblea Olio Novello 1025, 500ml
products.tagline: This oil was an olive a mere 3 weeks ago!
products.description: Made with the famous Tonda Iblea olives of the Monti Iblei region in Sicily. This amazing oil has green, ripe flavors that are in perfect balance. It is soft with a fresh, green tomato aroma and fruity flavor, like a perfectly ripe late summer heirloom tomato. A delightful complexity is extracted from this single varietal olive, a result of the craftsmanship that goes into the cultivation of rich soil. Spedalotto Tonda Iblea’s approachable flavor profile is easy to love!
